info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Interactive Help API
info.description: The Interactive Help API enables consumers to update and enhance customer assistance features across multiple banking channels. By allowing real-time modifications to support content and user guidance, this API assists financial institutions in maintaining updated help resources. Typical users include customer support teams and application developers who require seamless integration of interactive help features. This API ensures that users receive accurate, context-aware assistance to improve their banking experience.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific interactive help resource identified by its RES-100045 ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary changes in the request body to successfully modify the resource.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the interactive help content for the specified resource. It contains all the necessary details needed to apply the changes. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema.
